## Failures, by kind

| Kind | n | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| `no_candidate_url` | 53 | no open location anywhere — a genuine closed paper, or a record with no DOI and no repository copy |
| `route_blocked` | 33 | a 200 with an HTML body — **open content behind bot defence**; a browser-job, not a proxy-job |

**38 records OpenAlex calls OPEN ACCESS could not be fetched.** That gap is the honest measure of how much of the open literature is unreachable by script, and it is the population the browser handoff exists for.
